Name: Mushroom Tree Seed Recipe
Author: BadMoonBeast
Description:
[i]I'm a strong independent farmer and I don't need Qi gems to live out my fungusy fantasy life.

[/i][b]What It Does:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adds a recipe for Mushroom Tree Seed. To keep it as a more end-game item, it unlocks at Foraging 9 and requires Radioactive Ore.
[/list]
I can upload an easier to craft/earlier unlocked version, or even a harder to craft version, if there's interest. Let me know.

[b]Please note[/b] that you will require [b]both[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order for this mod to work.
